name: Brazil: ABNT standards NBR 9077 (exits), NBR 9050 (accessibility), NBR 15575 (housing performance)

review.note: Brazil has no national building code: ABNT standards apply nationally and municipal codes set room sizes and openings. Values from a 2001 NBR 9077 copy and secondary sources; current editions not confirmed. Width (1.10 m) is the emergency-exit rule and is not checked for houses. Not checked by this pack: stair width, stair headroom, glazing, share of floor area, openable area, share of floor area…

source.name: ABNT; municipal Códigos de Obras; state fire brigades, ABNT standards NBR 9077 (exits), NBR 9050 (accessibility), NBR 1…

rules.label: Handrail height
rules.note: NBR 9050 accessible routes: double handrails at 700 and 920 mm.

rules.label: Ceiling height
rules.note: 2.30 m allowed in halls, corridors, toilets and bathrooms. Municipal codes may require more.
